message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, from consumer‑facing sites to developer‑friendly APIs:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Consumer flight‑search & booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Search, compare, and book flights directly or via partner airlines. | Quick price comparison, multi‑city itineraries, flexible date searches. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates fares from many airlines and travel agencies. | “Price alerts,” “Explore” feature for budget travel. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global fare aggregator with “Everywhere” search. | Finding cheapest destinations or dates. |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Bundles flights with hotels, car rentals, and activities. | One‑stop booking for trips. |
| | **Priceline / Hotwire** | Offers “Name Your Own Price” and “Express Deals.” | Last‑minute or discounted fares. |
| | **Orbitz / Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia, often with loyalty points. | Frequent traveler programs. |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates fares and shows price trends. | Visual price comparison. |
| | **Airline‑specific sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Southwest, Ryanair, Air France) | Direct booking, loyalty benefits, seat selection. | When you prefer a specific carrier or want to use frequent‑flyer miles. |
| | **Travel agencies / OTAs** (e.g., Booking.com, TripAdvisor Flights) | Often bundle flights with other travel services. | All‑in‑one travel planning. |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Google Travel** | Integrates flight, hotel, and itinerary management. | On‑the‑go trip planning. |
| | **TripIt** | Organizes travel plans into a single itinerary. | Post‑booking organization. |
| | **Hopper** | Uses predictive analytics to suggest best booking times. | Timing your purchase for lowest price. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for price drops on specific routes. | Price‑sensitive travelers. |
| **Developer APIs** | **Skyscanner API** | Search flights, get pricing, and book via partner links. | Building custom flight search widgets. |
| | **Google Flights API (via Google Travel)** | Limited public API; often accessed via Google Flights web interface. | Integrating flight search into apps. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Offers multi‑carrier itineraries, “Kiwi.com” unique routing. | Complex itineraries, multi‑stop flights. |
| | **Amadeus Self‑Service APIs** | Flight offers, availability, booking, and ancillary services. | Enterprise travel tech solutions. |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Comprehensive travel data, booking, and inventory. | Large‑scale travel agencies. |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Global distribution system (GDS) access. | Corporate travel booking. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking). | Flight tracking, analytics. |
| **GDS (Global Distribution Systems)** | **Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport** | Connects travel agents to airline inventory. | Professional travel agencies, corporate travel. |
| **Chatbot / Voice Assistants** | **Amazon Alexa “Flight Booking” skill** | Voice‑controlled flight search and booking. | Hands‑free booking. |
| | **Google Assistant “Book a flight”** | Voice‑controlled booking via Google. | Quick bookings on mobile. |
| | **ChatGPT (with flight‑booking plugins)** | Natural‑language flight search and booking. | Conversational booking experience. |
| **Other Tools** | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking (no booking). | Monitoring flight status. |
| | **FlightAware** | Flight status, delays, and historical data. | Checking flight reliability. |
| | **FlightStats** | API for flight status, delays, and airport data. | Integrating flight status into apps. |

### How to Choose

| Need | Recommended Tool |
|------|------------------|
| **Fast, one‑stop booking** | Expedia, Kayak, Google Flights |
| **Lowest price search** | Skyscanner, Momondo, Hopper |
| **Specific airline loyalty** | Airline’s own site |
| **Bundle flights + hotels** | Expedia, Orbitz |
| **Last‑minute deals** | Priceline, Hotwire |
| **Custom app integration** | Skyscanner API, Amadeus, Sabre |
| **Voice‑controlled booking** | Alexa, Google Assistant |
| **Travel agency workflow** | GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any particular platform, how to integrate an API, or tips for getting the best deals!
